description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the BreeSpo helper component used in the BSP Run-time Execution Engine (BREE). It includes type definitions, a class content macro, and a basic message object structure.

classes.name: BREESPO_READER_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing a content filtering message object with associated properties and methods.

methods.name: PFN_BREESPO_READER_VALID
methods.description: Function pointer type for validating a BreeSpo reader object.
